name: [❤️VALENTINE❤️] Garden Incremental
desc:
🌳 Welcome to Garden Incremental!

🍎 Shake your tree to collect Seeds & Apples
🛠️ Buy upgrades to grow faster and unlock new features
💰 Discover new currencies as you progress further
🔄 Reset layers to gain powerful bonuses
✨ Reincarnate and start stronger every time
🥇 Compete on leaderboards and become the best gardener!

🤯 Premium players get a permanent +10% Luck boost!
💞  Like and Join the group for a FREE Auto Clicker & Boosts!
🎉 Join the Community Server to get codes and updates!
🚀 Like and Favorite the game for Boosts!
